goal.zh: 将 0.4 kg 包裹穿过自闭门，放在 B 桌并稳定释放。
goal.en: Carry the 0.4 kg parcel through the self-closing door, place it on table B and release it stably.

research_question.zh: 面对相同目标和物理机制，agent 能否通过发现工具、理解自身与队友能力边界，自主选择并执行有效的协作方案？
research_question.en: Given the same goal and physical mechanism, can an agent discover tools, infer its own and its partner’s capabilities, and choose and execute effective cooperation?

text.zh: heavy_prop 与 no_prop 是并列机制变体。L1/L2/L3 按物理约束、信息不确定性与决策需求定义。
text.en: heavy_prop and no_prop are parallel mechanisms. Define L1/L2/L3 by physical constraints, information uncertainty and decision demands.

text.zh: 修改包裹、把手或场景时，为所有对照机器人使用同一新版本；单纯换型号不证明 self-modeling。
text.en: Apply parcel, handle or scene revisions to every paired robot. Merely replacing a robot model does not demonstrate self-modeling.

text.zh: 同步记录门角度、角速度、支撑接触、包裹和机器人状态；检查组合包络从进入门区到完全离开的净空与支撑。最终接触力不能替代连续证据。
text.en: Synchronize door angle/velocity, support contacts, parcel and robot states. Check clearance and support from combined-envelope entry until full exit; final contact force is insufficient.

text.zh: 动作前记录可达、推力或抓取预测，动作后对照实测；证据不足记未确定。比较固定分工、主动探测和关闭更新的对照。
text.en: Record reach, force or grasp predictions before acting and compare with outcomes; insufficient evidence remains undetermined. Compare fixed roles, probing and no-update controls.

text.zh: 公开名义规格和合法控制接口；隐藏实际能力扰动、工具物理参数及故障真值。特权参考只用于可行性，不计为公开观测 agent 表现。
text.en: Expose nominal specifications and legal controls; hide actual capability perturbations, tool physics and fault ground truth. Privileged references establish feasibility, not public-sensor agent performance.

text.zh: 新组合先证明可行，再冻结预算；不直接沿用 180 秒。探测、通信、执行与恢复成本分别记录并纳入预算。
text.en: Establish feasibility before freezing new budgets; do not automatically reuse 180 seconds. Record and budget probing, communication, execution and recovery costs.

text.zh: 保留完整成功见证／通过可行性筛查／未确定／检查不通过。资产加载、局部验证、任务成功和正式准入分别记录，不要求每个随机 seed 都有完整专家解。
text.en: Retain complete witness / feasibility-screen passed / undetermined / check failed. Separate asset loading, local checks, task success and formal admission; a full expert solution is not required for every seed.

text.zh: 冻结参考成功数不是随机场景成功率。跨版本结果不得混算，新配置未验证时不得标为完成。
text.en: Frozen reference counts are not randomized success rates. Do not pool versions or mark unvalidated configurations complete.

text.zh: 首轮采用集中式 agent 控制双机。若研究独立多 agent，另行冻结各自观测、通信权限、延迟和同步规则。
text.en: Use centralized control of two robots initially. Independent-agent experiments additionally freeze each agent’s observations, communication permissions, latency and synchronization.

title.en: Use physical execution and legitimate faults

text.zh: 运行中禁止通过位置重设、隐藏吸附或修改物理参数制造成功；L3 仅允许可信侧执行预声明故障，保留原始记录。
text.en: Do not manufacture success with pose resets, hidden attachments or physics edits. L3 permits only predeclared trusted-side faults with raw records.

title.en: Freeze the task and experiment contract

requirement.zh: 明确机器人、夹爪、场景、包裹、观测权限和集中式／独立多 agent 控制方式；保留原 L1 基线。
requirement.en: Specify robots, grippers, scene, parcel, observation permissions and centralized versus independent-agent control; retain the original L1 baseline.

acceptance.zh: 版本化规格、可见／隐藏参数清单及资产清单。
acceptance.en: Versioned specification, public/hidden parameter list and asset inventory.

progress.zh: 合同已有；准入未通过；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Contract recorded; admission pending; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 使用真实 Stretch 4 固定版本资产，不能以 Stretch 3 替代；验证纵移、横移、转向、停止、升降和伸缩。
requirement.en: Use pinned, actual Stretch 4 assets, without substituting Stretch 3; verify translation, strafing, rotation, stopping, lift and extension.

acceptance.zh: 单体控制实测、驱动限值与原始轨迹。
acceptance.en: Measured single-robot controls, actuator limits and raw trajectories.

progress.zh: 导航与驱动已测；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Navigation and drives measured; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 对 20 × 18 × 16 cm、0.4 kg 包裹实际完成抓取、运输和桌面释放；额定载荷不能替代抓取验证。
requirement.en: Physically grasp, transport and release the 20 × 18 × 16 cm, 0.4 kg parcel; rated payload alone does not establish graspability.

acceptance.zh: 稳定操作见证；若改变包裹，对所有配对机器人使用同一新版本。
acceptance.en: Stable manipulation witness; any parcel revision is shared by every paired embodiment.

progress.zh: G1 搬运已测；Stretch 抓取未通过；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: G1 carry measured; Stretch grasp unproven; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

status_label.zh: G1 搬运已测；Stretch 抓取未通过
status_label.en: G1 carry measured; Stretch grasp unproven

requirement.zh: 分别配置动作维度、驱动、抓持接触组、碰撞包络和稳定性判定；不能复用 G1 身高阈值判定轮式机器人跌倒。
requirement.en: Configure action dimensions, drives, grasp contacts, collision envelopes and stability checks per embodiment; do not apply the G1 root-height fall threshold to a wheeled robot.

acceptance.zh: G1 与 Stretch 在共享时钟下运行，所有动作经受限驱动执行。
acceptance.en: G1 and Stretch operate on a shared clock through bounded actuators.

progress.zh: 共享异构接口已实现；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Shared heterogeneous interface implemented; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 支持单臂抓取；检查完整穿门区间；隐藏实际参数不得经元数据或特权参考接口泄漏。
requirement.en: Support single-arm grasping, evaluate the entire crossing interval, and prevent hidden actual parameters leaking through metadata or privileged reference interfaces.

acceptance.zh: 评分检查、隔离检查、同步记录及独立重放；保留旧版评分。
acceptance.en: Scoring and isolation checks, synchronized records and independent replay; preserve the legacy scorer.

status_label.zh: 连续评分已实现；隔离闭环待完成

progress.zh: 连续评分已实现；隔离闭环待完成；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Continuous scoring implemented; isolation pending; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 按用户确认的分工，以 G1 搬运原包裹、Stretch 扶门或布置工具验证物理可行性；全程真实接触，禁止运行中位置重设或隐藏吸附。
requirement.en: Use the user-confirmed route: G1 carries the original parcel and Stretch supports the door or places tools. Verify real contact throughout, without runtime pose resets or hidden attachment.

acceptance.zh: 至少一条完整交付见证及独立审计；这条参考路线不规定 agent 必须采用同一分工。
acceptance.en: At least one complete delivery witness and independent audit; the reference does not prescribe the agent’s role allocation.

status_label.zh: L1 完整见证已有；正式准入未通过

progress.zh: L1 完整见证已有；正式准入未通过；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Complete L1 witnesses; admission pending; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 首轮提供真实楔块、重箱和一个干扰物；检查撤去辅助后的支撑与通道占用；支撑杆留到后续。
requirement.en: Start with a physical wedge, heavy crate and one distractor; check support after assistance is removed and passage occupancy; defer the brace rod.

acceptance.zh: 工具碰撞几何、稳定性、滑移与通行验证。
acceptance.en: Verified tool collision geometry, stability, slip and passage clearance.

status_label.zh: 局部工具筛查与布置已测
status_label.en: Local tool screening and placement measured

progress.zh: 局部工具筛查与布置已测；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Local tool screening and placement measured; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 保持外观和几何一致，只改变指定摩擦或闭门参数；考虑材料组合规则，实测确认结果发生变化。
requirement.en: Keep appearance and geometry matched, changing only the specified friction or closer parameter; account for contact-material combination and measure the resulting difference.

acceptance.zh: 同一放置动作产生可复现的稳定／失效差异；保留可行路线证据。
acceptance.en: The same placement produces reproducible stable/failing outcomes, with evidence for a feasible route.

status_label.zh: 局部物理反事实配对已测

progress.zh: 局部物理反事实配对已测；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Local physical counterfactuals measured; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

title.zh: 实现工具发现与动态分工

requirement.zh: 不标注有效工具；通过预测、探测和反馈验证 affordance；包含工具必要或有明确成本收益的实例。
requirement.en: Do not label effective tools; predict, probe and verify affordances through feedback; include instances where a tool is necessary or has a defined cost benefit.

acceptance.zh: 探测、选择、撤去辅助验证、交接与重分配轨迹。
acceptance.en: Traces of probing, selection, withdrawal checks, support handoff and role reassignment.

status_label.zh: 单候选交付通过；自主选择待完成
status_label.en: Single-candidate delivery passed; autonomous choice pending

progress.zh: 413.92 s 关门起始完整交付通过独立复算；三次固定重复在验。自主多工具选择仍缺。
progress.en: Closed-door delivery passed in 413.92 s with an independent audit; three fixed repeats are running. Autonomous multi-tool choice remains missing.

requirement.zh: 同场景比较双 G1 与 G1 + Stretch 4；统一感知、接口和预算条件；动作前记录能力预测。
requirement.en: Compare dual G1 and G1 + Stretch 4 in matched scenes with matched sensing, interfaces and budgets; record capability predictions before actions.

acceptance.zh: 固定分工、主动探测、关闭探测／在线更新的对照；角色调整收益与路径规划收益分开。
acceptance.en: Fixed-role, active-probing and no-probe/no-update controls; distinguish role adaptation from path-planning gains.

requirement.zh: 预声明故障触发规则、幅度和允许变化；由可信侧执行并记录，与未授权修改物理参数区分。
requirement.en: Predeclare fault triggers, magnitude and allowed changes; execute and record on the trusted side, separately from unauthorized physics changes.

acceptance.zh: 事件可重放，合法故障不被误判为 VOID，未授权修改仍被拒绝。
acceptance.en: Replayable events; legitimate faults are not misclassified as VOID and unauthorized changes remain rejected.

status_label.zh: 可信故障已实现并审计

progress.zh: 可信故障已实现并审计；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Trusted faults implemented and audited; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 一次只引入一种故障；先证明存在可恢复条件；记录能力更新及角色切换。
requirement.en: Introduce one fault type at a time, first establish recoverability, and record capability updates and role changes.

acceptance.zh: 从故障到恢复交付的完整轨迹、恢复成功率及额外成本。
acceptance.en: Complete fault-to-delivery traces, recovery success and additional cost.

status_label.zh: 局部恢复已测；完整交付待完成
status_label.en: Local recovery measured; full delivery pending

progress.zh: 局部恢复已测；完整交付待完成；逐次证据见实施看板。
progress.en: Local recovery measured; full delivery pending; see the acceptance board for individual evidence.

requirement.zh: 双 Stretch 4、G1 + Go2/Z1 先分别完成单体能力与场景可行性验证；A3 为后续候选。
requirement.en: Validate individual capabilities and scene feasibility before dual Stretch 4 or G1 + Go2/Z1 tasks; retain A3 as a later candidate.

acceptance.zh: 每个新组合独立证据和预算，不能继承其他机器人的成功结论。
acceptance.en: Separate evidence and budget for each pairing; no transfer of success claims between embodiments.

evidence.zh: 完整成功见证：冻结 1/1，102.22 s
单候选关门起始完整原生交付 413.92 s 通过独立复算；固定重复在验。自主多工具发现未完成。
evidence.en: Single-candidate closed-door native delivery passed in 413.92 s with independent audit; fixed repeats are pending. Autonomous multi-tool discovery remains incomplete.

evidence.zh: 双 Stretch 尚未完成独立实现与验证，不能继承混合双机结论。
evidence.en: Dual Stretch has no independently verified implementation; mixed-pair results do not transfer.

evidence.zh: 局部支撑切换固定重复 3/3；局部恢复后交付 211.48 s。新增关门起始实际故障恢复，但后续切换失败；新余量候选在验。
evidence.en: Local support switching passed 3/3 fixed repeats; local recovery-to-delivery passed in 211.48 s. Closed-door actual fault recovery is now verified, but the later switch failed; an angle-reserve revision is being tested.

evidence.zh: 组合资产预检未完成；无物理运行。
evidence.en: Composite asset preflight incomplete; no physics run.

definition.zh: 撤去辅助后，选定工具是否维持有效支撑并允许实际通过；持续扶门另记策略。
definition.en: Whether the selected tool maintains support after assistance is removed and permits actual passage; continuous robot holding is recorded separately.

definition.zh: 动作前预测与实测结果的一致性，记录置信度与未确定项；不能用事后解释替代预测。
definition.en: Agreement between pre-action predictions and outcomes, including confidence and undetermined cases; post-hoc explanation is not a prediction.

definition.zh: 分工可行性、失败重分配次数及相对同条件参考的成本；未定义成本时不声称最优。
definition.en: Feasible roles, failed reassignments and cost against a matched reference; do not claim optimality without a cost definition.

definition.zh: 整个穿门区间的最小净空、支撑中断时长、支撑来源和交接事件；阈值通过物理验证后冻结。
definition.en: Minimum clearance, unsupported duration, support source and handoff events throughout crossing; freeze thresholds after physical validation.

definition.zh: 在预声明且可恢复的故障实例中，恢复安全支撑并完成交付；记录不可恢复实例。
definition.en: Restore safe support and complete delivery under predeclared recoverable faults; report unrecoverable cases separately.

definition.zh: 探测动作、仿真时间、观测／通信次数及每台机器人占用时间，恢复额外成本单列。
definition.en: Probe actions, simulation time, observation/communication counts and robot occupancy; separate additional recovery cost.

measured_progress.zh: L2 单候选关门起始交付 413.92 s 通过；自主多工具发现仍待验。 固定重复已完成 0/3，通过 0/3，首例不计入。 L3 支撑切换固定重复 3/3 通过。 局部夹具后恢复至原包裹交付 211.48 s 通过；关门起始故障交付待验。 另已验证无夹具关门起始的真实故障恢复；后续扶门切换未通过。 正式验收仍未通过。
measured_progress.en: L2 single-candidate closed-door delivery passed in 413.92 s; autonomous multi-tool discovery remains pending. Fixed repeats: 0/3 completed, 0/3 passed; pilot excluded. L3 support switching passed 3/3 fixed repeats. Recovery-to-parcel delivery after a local fixture passed in 211.48 s; closed-door fault delivery remains pending. Actual fault recovery from a closed-door start without a fixture is also verified; the subsequent support switch failed. Formal admission remains pending.
